summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of ANCRSHOP. 25/26 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified: home, departments (25 listed, matching seeded superset of 19), shop filters/sort/search, PDP + variant + add-to-cart, cart drawer, wishlist toggle, wishlist page, checkout with CREATOR10 coupon (discount applied and total updates), Stripe redirect to real checkout.stripe.com session, AIAH concierge returns contextual reply + 4 product recommendations, login/logout/register (except register 500 bug), RBAC redirect for non-admin /admin, admin dashboard shows stats + product list (42 rows on Products tab). Stripe hosted checkout could not be completed end-to-end in Playwright because card fields are inside cross-origin iframes with anti-automation protection - however the create-session flow, order persistence, and payment-status polling endpoint are all validated via backend tests.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Root cause: register() returns the raw `doc` dict which motor's insert_one mutates by injecting `_id: ObjectId`. FastAPI cannot JSON-encode ObjectId. Fix: use `serialize(doc)` before returning (like login does) or explicitly pop `_id`. Blocks new user signup entirely.

minor.issue: Called from Home for guest users, returns 401 and spams browser console. Guard frontend calls with auth state or return empty list for anonymous users.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Sort <select> options contain span elements which is invalid HTML.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete Stripe hosted checkout via automation (Stripe uses cross-origin iframes + hCaptcha). The redirect to checkout.stripe.com works and orders are persisted with pending status; suggest main agent verify /payment/success rendering + order-paid marking manually or via Stripe CLI trigger of checkout.session.completed webhook.

action_items: Fix POST /api/auth/register 500 — return serialize(doc) or pop _id before returning to avoid ObjectId serialization crash. Currently new-account signup is completely broken.

Manually verify Stripe test-card 4242 payment completes and /payment/success shows order confirmation with ANCR- number and order becomes payment_status=paid in DB (auto-test blocked by Stripe iframe/captcha).
Fix Shop sort-select: replace inline <span> children of <option> with plain text to remove React hydration warning.
Suppress or gate the /api/wishlist call for unauthenticated users on Home to avoid 401 console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py register(): returning `doc` after `insert_one` leaks ObjectId `_id` from motor. Always call serialize() before returning; mirrors login() pattern.
payments.py _mark_paid uses __import__('bson').ObjectId inline — move to top-level import for readability and to fail-fast on missing dep.
aiah.py uses model gpt-5.4 (July-2026 non-canonical) — verify against current Emergent LLM model list; consider gpt-5 or claude-opus-5 for stability.

rca_of_the_issue: Register 500: FastAPI runs jsonable_encoder on the returned dict. motor's insert_one mutates the input dict adding `_id: ObjectId`. ObjectId is not JSON-serializable causing TypeError. Fix in /app/backend/auth.py register(): replace `return doc` with `return serialize(doc)` OR add `doc.pop('_id', None)` after inserting. Reproduce: POST /api/auth/register {'email':'x@y.com','password':'pw','name':'x'} -> 500.
